definitions.explanation: The act of temporarily suspending or postponing something, typically a service, plan, or decision. Very commonly heard in train announcements when service is suspended.

examples.japanese: {運転|うんてん}{見合|みあ}わせが{続|つづ}いている。
{台風|たいふう}のため、{全線|ぜんせん}で{運転|うんてん}を{見合|みあ}わせています。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, service is suspended on all lines.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}が{確認|かくにん}できるまで{工事|こうじ}の{見合|みあ}わせを{決定|けってい}した。
examples.english: They decided to suspend the construction until safety can be confirmed.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in the phrase {運転|うんてん}{見合|みあ}わせ (service suspension), heard frequently in Japanese train station announcements when trains are stopped due to weather, accidents, or other disruptions. The verb form is {見合|みあ}わせる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運転|うんてん}{見合|みあ}わせ (service suspension)
- {見合|みあ}わせが{発生|はっせい}する (a suspension occurs)
- 〜を{見合|みあ}わせる (to hold off on ~, to postpone ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中止|ちゅうし}: cancellation — more final; not just a temporary pause
- {延期|えんき}: postponement — rescheduling to a later date
- {一時停止|いちじていし}: temporary stop — more technical
